capabilities: Compute word counts, streaks and writing stats from a single vault scan
Visualize writing rhythm with heatmaps, punch cards and a 24-hour clock chart
Rank tags, folders, linked notes and frequent words by writing volume
Score vault health and list cleanup issues like orphan and stale notes
Generate and export a shareable year-in-review PNG card with captions
disambiguation: Not a journaling or diary plugin; it only visualizes statistics computed from the notes already in your vault.
extras: Read-only: stores nothing, not even data.json, and makes no network requests. Daily output is attributed by last modification date, so daily word counts are estimates; the README states no dependency on Dataview or Templater.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard for writing output, productivity rhythm, tag/topic trends, or vault health across the whole vault.
summary: Vault analytics dashboard that computes writing stats, heatmaps, streaks, tag and folder trends, and a shareable year-in-review card from one vault scan.
